title: Fix duty cycle ring buffer overflow test timing
description: test_duty_cycle_ring_buffer_overflow at lines 1406-1449 has incorrect timing assertions. At query time 3600001ms, no records are pruned because the oldest record (ts=0, dur=100) ends at t=100, which is > window_start (1). Two fixes needed: (1) Line 1438: Expected remaining should be 32801ms, not 36000ms. (2) Line 1443: record_tx should return false (buffer still full), not true. Either adjust query time to 3631100ms to prune all records, or fix assertions to match partial-pruning behavior.
close_reason: Added test_ring_buffer_overflow_timing with correct assertions: remaining_ms=32801 at query time 3600001ms (verifying partial overlap calculation), and record_tx returns false when buffer is full with non-evicted records
